messages:
jules (eng-runtime): Heads up — after yesterday's kernel-path + micro-batch tweak, we're seeing a noisy tail on host-side streaming for very short inputs (~<40 tokens). p50 OK but p95 blown up. Anyone digging in? :thinking:

maya (eng-runtime): Yep. Alert dashboards show p95 jump from ~30ms to ~140ms on canary. Throughput stable.

zoe (perf): I grabbed a short CPU+syscall trace. Top lines look like tokenize + small writev storm. Looks like the fast-path skipped message coalescing. pprof: internal link (pprof.redwood/5876/brief).

raj (eng-ml): Did the kernel selector change how we validate model variants? We landed extra metadata fields in the hash last week (quant flags + build_id). If that makes the validate path run more often it could force tokenizer rebuilds.

jules (eng-runtime): I instrumented the path. Sequence observed on affected requests:
  kernel_path::choose -> validate_variant() -> maybe_rebuild_tokenizer() -> tokenize() -> stream_emit
When validate_variant() returns 'rebuild' we clear and reallocate tokenizer buffers even if model hasn't logically changed.

zoe (perf): flame snippet:
```
28.4% tokenize_worker
19.7% writev/syscall
12.2% validate_variant
8.9% kv_cache::lookup
```

maya (eng-runtime): Also saw a shift in batching: micro-batches are smaller after the heuristic change (window 4ms -> 1.5ms). Smaller batches mean more separate KV lookups per-request and fewer amortized ops. Combined with extra tokenizer churn, that's rough.

raj (eng-ml): kv_cache metrics show hit-rate dip for small batches. Our code keeps a per-batch prefetch path that used to amortize lookups; with micro-batches those prefetch calls happen more frequently and thrash L1.

jules (eng-runtime): tcpdump shows many 512B writes where previously we'd get 2-4KB coalesced frames. That increases syscalls and kernel scheduling.

maya (eng-runtime): Repro command I used:
```
wrk -t10 -c220 -d60s --script=short_stream.lua http://canary:8080/v1/stream
```

zoe (perf): Latency hist before->after (canary A):
```
p50: 29ms -> 31ms
p90: 44ms -> 58ms
p95: 30ms -> 142ms
p99: 92ms -> 380ms
```

jules (eng-runtime): Candidate root causes:
- validate_variant hash instability (new metadata fields)
- tokenizer pool being cleared on false-positive rebuilds
- micro-batch heuristic reducing batch size -> more KV lookups
- streaming path bypassing MSG_MORE/coalesce in some fast-paths

raj (eng-ml): quick mitigation ideas:
- revert micro-batch window to previous value (fast)
- make validate_variant hash only include stable fields (medium)
- avoid clearing tokenizer pool unless actual binary change (medium)
- force MSG_MORE coalescing in streaming layer while we triage (fast)

maya (eng-runtime): I can push a focused hotfix: stable-hash + guard so tokenizer pool isn't destroyed if model_id + quant_profile equal. Small change ~30 LOC.

zoe (perf): I prototyped forcing MSG_MORE in the streaming emitter locally. That reduced syscall count by ~60% and brought p95 down to ~60ms in repro. Patch gist: internal/gists/5876-msgmore.

jules (eng-runtime): deploy-bot — can we rollback kernel-path feature on canaries while we land the hotfix?

deploy-bot: Initiating rollback of feature kernel-path on canary hosts (canary-1..3). Started at 11:22. Status: in-progress.

raj (eng-ml): If we revert kernel-path only, micro-batching remains risky. Recommend rollback + short hold on batching change.

maya (eng-runtime): I'll open the stable-hash PR and include a unit test that simulates optional extra fields (build_id, timestamps) so hash stays stable. Also add a small integration perf test (wrk script) to guard merge.

zoe (perf): I'll add a perf-regression CI job that runs the short_stream scenario and fails if p95 increases >20%. Also will baseline writev counts per-second.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed on canary hosts. Health checks passing.

maya (eng-runtime): Canary p95 back to ~48ms after rollback. Holding full rollout until PR merged + MSG_MORE guard.

jules (eng-runtime): Action items:
- rollback (done)
- land stable-hash + tokenizer-pool guard PR (maya)
- land MSG_MORE coalesce guard in streaming emitter (zoe/infra)
- add perf CI gating for kernel-path and batching heuristics (zoe)
- long-term: KV-prefetch for tiny batches + model-variant e2e perf tests (team)

raj (eng-ml): Also let's add telemetry for 'validate_variant' outcomes so we can see frequency of rebuilds post-change.

zoe (perf): noted. i'll add a metric (validate.rebuild_count) and a dashboard.

jules (eng-runtime): thanks team. i'll post a summary to #release-war-room and block the rollout until green. tagging for a postmortem after fixes land.

maya (eng-runtime): thanks all.
